verdict.rationale: Adyen provides first-party webhook subscriptions to avoid polling, with event logs visible in the Customer Area, and MCP tools to list/get/test webhooks, plus agentic-commerce flows that explicitly send webhook payment outcomes to merchant servers — showing webhooks are usable both directly and via AI-native/agent tooling. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer confirmation of webhook subscription setup via API or MCP, and no detail on webhook event types/payload schema management through natural-language/agentic tooling.
